description: Export memories to JSON, Markdown, or claude-md (compact LLM-optimized) format. Supports filtering by layer, scope, date range. Returns the exported content as a string.

date_from.description: Filter: event date (event_at if set, else created_at) >= ISO 8601 date

date_to.description: Filter: event date (event_at if set, else created_at) <= ISO 8601 date

format.description: Export format: json (structured), markdown (human-readable), claude-md (compact for LLM context)

layers.description: Filter by memory layers (omit for all)

name: memory_export
